title.description: Chapter title or number, one entry per language.

topic.description: Slug of the mochott writing topic (投稿のお題) this work participates in.

covers.description: Ordered site.mochott.comic.cover records; the first is primary.

labels.description: Self-labels for this chapter or strip alone. work.sequential only labels whole series; mochott applies these in addition to the series labels.

series.description: AT URI of the parent site.mochott.comic.series.

credits.description: People who worked on the chapter.

category.description: mochott platform category slug, used to list the work alongside articles.

updatedAt.description: When the chapter was last updated.

sequential.description: AT URI of the canonical work.sequential record this record accompanies. Same record key. Omitted only when the work exists solely in this namespace.

description.description: Chapter description, one entry per language.

spreadStart.description: Where page 1 sits in a two-page view. 'latter' (the default when absent) puts page 1 in the second slot of the first spread, facing the cover or standing alone, so spreads are pages 2–3, 4–5…; 'former' pairs pages 1–2, 3–4…. Readers showing one page at a time ignore it.

minisiteCategory.description: Category of the work within a mochott minisite.

main.description: A chapter in a comic series.

description: A chapter of a comic series on mochott. Written beside the work.sequential.chapter of the same record key as a complete copy that also holds mochott extensions.
